_comment: Versions of KWin and Qt the Fenestra session (KWin + Fenestra Shell) was validated with.
'bench' = tests/shell-kwin passed; 'real' = used on a real machine. Fenestra Update checks the
next Fedora release's KWin and Qt: if either major.minor is not listed, users whose default
session is Fenestra are switched to GNOME before the restart (recorded, so it can be undone
once a Fenestra update validates the new versions). Fenestra Shell uses Qt's private Wayland
client API, so it is rebuilt for every Qt minor version.
